content.text: Digital creators face significant hurdles when trying to sell music online, especially in regions where platforms like Stripe are unavailable. This limitation forces many to miss out on potential revenue. Fortunately, there’s an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-how-kenyan-creators-get-paid-5|infrastructure]] solution that enables creators to accept Bitcoin for their music without relying on traditional payment processors. This breakdown will explain how you can set up your own digital music store with minimal fees and full ownership.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online has traditionally been hampered by platforms that impose high fees and restrictions. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on each sale, which can severely cut into profits for music creators. In contrast, using a system built with NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin with only a 0.5% fee. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-13|COREMERCH guide to difference]]-between-choices-selling-courses-pakistan-without-11|The Real]] means that with just 100 sales per month at $97 each, you could retain an additional $921. Understanding this infrastructure shift is crucial for maximizing your earnings and maintaining control over your digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the infrastructure you're using consists of several free and powerful tools. You can host your store on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which eliminates hosting costs. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate processes such as payment verification and order fulfillment. This architecture ensures that once deployed, you own all aspects of your store, from the product listings to customer data, without being tied to any third-party platform.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment processors are unavailable. Musicians, educators, and designers in Nigeria, Ghana, and other similar markets can leverage this infrastructure to sell their products directly to their audience. By opting for this architecture, creators gain the ability to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, empowering them to bypass traditional banking obstacles and retain full control over their sales and customer interactions.
Retain up to $921 more with lower fees on each sale.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The system comprises several key components that work in unison. First, you have the hosting service, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, for your storefront. Next, backend processes are managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring seamless order processing. NOWPayments handles cryptocurrency transactions, converting Bitcoin to USD at the time of sale. All of these elements are integrated to provide a smooth user experience for your customers while ensuring you maintain ownership and control over your data and sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Begin by selecting your hosting platform—either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—then set up your digital storefront. Integrate the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate processes. Next, connect to NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, upload your music products and configure automatic delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. By following these steps, you can establish a fully operational online store without relying on traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Your digital products are yours—no platform can take them away.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can use platforms like NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin for your ebooks. By setting up a self-hosted storefront with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you can directly manage your sales without relying on traditional payment processors.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payments allows you to sell digital downloads with minimal fees. This architecture ensures you retain full ownership of your products.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can create your own storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency. This approach allows you to avoid the high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than competitors like Gumroad. It allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and offers automatic webhook notifications upon payment confirmation, streamlining your sales process.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?

Yes, you can automate product delivery by using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your files and integrate them with your backend setup. This ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment.
